description: A 3-axis accelerometer + 3-axis gyroscope + temperature sensor with an I2C interface (default address 0x68, or 0x69 with AD0 tied to VCC).
how_to_use: VCC/GND power, SDA/SCL are real I2C — wire to the board's real I2C pins. XDA/XCL (auxiliary I2C bus) aren't implemented in Wokwi's simulation, and AD0/INT are usually left unconnected unless changing the I2C address or using the interrupt pin.
